# Global cache variables outside get_text()
_cached_data = None
_cache_timestamp = 0

def get_text():
    import urllib.request
    import json
    import time
    from datetime import datetime
    
    global _cached_data, _cache_timestamp
    current_time = time.time()
    CACHE_DURATION = 1800  # 30 minutes in seconds

    try:
        # Fetch fresh data only if cache is empty or older than 30 minutes
        if _cached_data is None or (current_time - _cache_timestamp) > CACHE_DURATION:
            url = "https://lldev.thespacedevs.com/2.2.0/launch/upcoming/?limit=1&hide_recent_previous=true&status=1"
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "PyPixelColorMatrix/4.0 (MatrixDisplay)"})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as response:
                _cached_data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
                _cache_timestamp = current_time
                
        data = _cached_data
            
        launches = data.get("results", [])
        if not launches:
            return "No upcoming launches"
            
        next_launch = launches[0]
        
        # Parse launch time (UTC)
        net_str = next_launch.get("net")
        if not net_str:
            return "Launch time TBA"
        net_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(net_str.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        local_dt = net_dt.astimezone()
        
        # Extract Rocket Name / Abbreviation
        rocket_info = next_launch.get("rocket", {}).get("configuration", {})
        rocket_abbr = rocket_info.get("name", "Rocket")
        rocket_abbr = rocket_abbr.replace("Falcon 9", "F9").replace("Falcon Heavy", "FH")
        
        # Extract country_code from pad -> location
        pad_info = next_launch.get("pad", {})
        location_info = pad_info.get("location", {})
        country_raw = location_info.get("country_code", "")
        country_code = country_raw.split(",")[0].strip().upper() if country_raw else "US"
        
        # Comprehensive 3-letter to 2-letter ISO mapping to prevent bad truncation
        alpha3_map = {
            "USA": "US", "CHN": "CN", "RUS": "RU", "IND": "IN", 
            "JPN": "JP", "FRA": "FR", "NZL": "NZ", "GBR": "GB", 
            "KOR": "KR", "ITA": "IT", "DEU": "DE", "BRA": "BR",
            "AUS": "AU", "CAN": "CA", "IRN": "IR", "PRK": "KP", "KAZ": "KZ"
        }
        
        # Look up safely; if not found, default to "US" or keep if already 2 letters
        if len(country_code) == 3:
            country_code = alpha3_map.get(country_code, "US")
        elif len(country_code) != 2:
            country_code = "US"

        def country_to_flag(code):
            if not code or len(code) != 2:
                return "🚀"
            return chr(ord(code[0]) + 127397) + chr(ord(code[1]) + 127397)
            
        flag = country_to_flag(country_code)
        date_formatted = local_dt.strftime("%b %d %H:%M")
        
        return f"{flag} {rocket_abbr}\n {date_formatted}"
        
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        if e.code == 429:
            return "API Rate Limit (429)"
        return f"HTTP Err: {e.code}"
    except Exception as e:
        return f"Err: {str(e)[:15]}"
